name: BoundingSieve
siftedsum_eq_sum_support_mul_ite
result.signature: ∀ {s : BoundingSieve}, BoundingSieve.siftedSum = ∑ d ∈ s.support, s.weights d * if s.prodPrimes.gcd d = 1 then 1 else 0
result.type: ∀ {s : BoundingSieve}, BoundingSieve.siftedSum = ∑ d ∈ s.support, s.weights d * if s.prodPrimes.gcd d = 1 then 1 else 0
result.informal_name: Sifted Sum Equality in Bounding Sieve
result.informal_description: For any bounding sieve $ s $, the sifted sum $ s.\text{siftedSum} $ equals the sum over all $ d \in s.\text{support} $ of $ s.\text{weights}(d) $ multiplied by the indicator function $ \mathbf{1}_{\gcd(s.\text{prodPrimes}, d) = 1} $, i.e., $ \sum_{d \in s.\text{support}} s.\text{weights}(d) \cdot \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } \gcd(s.\text{prodPrimes}, d) = 1 \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} $.

result.informal_description: For any bounding sieve $s$, the product of the primes associated with $s$ is non-zero, i.e., $\prod_{p \in s} p \neq 0$.

result.informal_name: Sifted Sum Equals Weighted Sum with Coprimality Condition
result.informal_description: For a bounding sieve $ s $, the sifted sum $ s.siftedSum $ is equal to the sum over all $ d $ in the support of $ s $ of $ s.weights(d) $ multiplied by $ 1 $ if $ \gcd(s.prodPrimes, d) = 1 $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Symbolically, $ s.siftedSum = \sum_{d \in s.support} s.weights(d) \cdot \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } \gcd(s.prodPrimes, d) = 1, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise}. \end{cases} $

result.informal_name: Right Endpoint Sum Inequality for Decreasing Functions
result.informal_description: For a function $ f $ that is decreasing on the closed interval $[x_0, x_0 + a]$, the sum of $ f(x_0 + i + 1) $ for $ i = 0 $ to $ a - 1 $ is less than or equal to the integral of $ f $ over $[x_0, x_0 + a]$. Formally, $\sum_{i=0}^{a-1} f(x_0 + i + 1) \leq \int_{x_0}^{x_0 + a} f(x) \, dx$.

name: AntitoneOn
integral_le_sum_Ico
result.signature: (hab : a ≤ b) (hf : AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc a b)) : (∫ x in a..b, f x) ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f x
result.type: ∀ {a b : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ}, a ≤ b → AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc ↑a ↑b) → ∫ (x : ℝ) in ↑a..↑b, f x ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.Ico a b, f ↑x
result.value:
:= by
  rw [(Nat.sub_add_cancel hab).symm, Nat.cast_add]
  conv =>
    congr
    congr
    · skip
    · skip
    rw [add_comm]
    · skip
    · skip
    congr
    congr
    rw [← zero_add a]
  rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_add, Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range]
  conv =>
    rhs
    congr
    · skip
    ext
    rw [Nat.cast_add]
  apply AntitoneOn.integral_le_sum
  simp only [hf, hab, Nat.cast_sub, add_sub_cancel]
result.informal_name: Integral of Antitone Function is Less Than or Equal to Discrete Sum Over Interval
result.informal_description: For natural numbers $a \leq b$ and a function $f$ that is antitone (decreasing) on the closed interval $[a, b]$, the integral of $f$ from $a$ to $b$ is less than or equal to the sum of $f(x)$ evaluated at each integer point in the half-open interval $[a, b)$, i.e., $\int_a^b f(x) \, dx \leq \sum_{x = a}^{b - 1} f(x)$.

name: MeasureTheory
exists_integral_le
result.signature: (hf : Integrable f μ) : ∃ x, ∫ a, f a ∂μ ≤ f x
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {f : α → ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ], MeasureTheory.Integrable f μ → ∃ x, ∫ (a : α), f a ∂μ ≤ f x
result.value: := by simpa only [average_eq_integral] using exists_average_le (IsProbabilityMeasure.ne_zero μ) hf
result.informal_name: Integral Upper Bound by Function Value
result.informal_description: If $ f $ is integrable with respect to the measure $ \mu $, then there exists a point $ x $ such that the integral of $ f $ with respect to $ \mu $ satisfies $ \int f(a) \, d\mu \leq f(x) $.

result.informal_name: Integral of Monotone Function is Less Than or Equal to Right Endpoint Sum
result.informal_description: For a non-decreasing function $ f $ on the closed interval $[x_0, x_0 + a]$, the integral of $ f $ from $ x_0 $ to $ x_0 + a $ satisfies $$ \int_{x_0}^{x_0 + a} f(x) \, dx \leq \sum_{k=1}^a f(x_0 + k). $$
